work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. XX heading 10596/synopsis 10598–10600 follow prior dating 10589–10593; self-protocol 10602–10603. The bishops/regulars congregational decree is expressly introduced as decretum tenoris qui sequitur at 10622–10625; its quoted text closes 10654 and signatures follow 10656–10657. Papal narrative resumes at §2 10659 and explicitly confirms the praeinsertum decree 10685–10690, proving incorporation. Own notes 10610 and 10667–10669 attach to local markers. Ordered remaining clauses reach own complete dating 10734–10738 before XXI heading 10741. No reversed body order found.
